title: How Many Islands Does the Philippines Really Have?
takeaways: It's no longer 7,107: modern NAMRIA mapping added 534 islands, bringing the count to 7,641.
More than 5,000 of these islands still have no official name.
The three stars on the flag stand for Luzon, Visayas and Mindanao.

quiz.q: How many islands does the Philippines have, according to NAMRIA?
What is the largest island in the Philippines?
Where is the northernmost tip of the Philippines?
What do the three stars on our flag stand for?

paragraphs: Did you know? The Philippines no longer has 7,107 islands. It has 7,641! Yes, the number we all memorized in school came from old surveys, long before satellites. When NAMRIA switched to modern mapping, 534 islands were added to the count!

And did you know this too? More than 5,000 of these islands still don't have an official name! The biggest of them all? Luzon, home to more than half of all Filipinos. Mindanao comes second, and in between them sit the many islands of the Visayas.

That's why our flag has three stars: for Luzon, Visayas and Mindanao. The northernmost tip of the country? Batanes, which is actually closer to Taiwan than to Manila! And here's another one: with so many islands, our coastline stretches more than 36,000 kilometers, one of the longest in the world!
So if you visited one island a day, it would take you more than 20 years!
